name: Agentic Finance x AI Security - Bangkok Side Event
description:
Event Overview

As autonomous agents move from demos to holding keys, routing capital, and settling on-chain, two questions decide who wins: what can agents actually do with money, and how do we keep them - and the rails beneath them - safe. Agentic finance is moving fast, but the infrastructure for agent-held assets, agent-to-agent payments, and verifiable agent behavior is still being built, and the security assumptions behind it are being tested in real time.

This side event brings both sides of that question onto one stage. We convene the builders defining agentic finance and the teams securing it - for an opening keynote, two moderated panels on Agentic Finance and AI Security, and a closing Braindates session - as a Binance Blockchain Week Bangkok 2026 side event.

Agenda

13:30 - 14:00 Registration + Welcome Drinks

14:00 - 14:10 Keynote 1: dLife

14:10 - 14:20 Keynote 2: Junto

14:20 - 15:00 Panel Discussion 1: Agentic Finance

15:00 - 15:10 Break

15:10 - 15:50 Panel Discussion 2: AI Security

15:50 - 17:00 Braindates & Networking

Welcome drinks will be provided.

Organizers Introduction
Host

Junto
Junto is an AI-first trading terminal that brings US-stock perpetuals, crypto, meme scanning, and paper agents into one conversational workspace. It is built for traders who want to turn a market idea into a rule, backtest it, and see what actually happened - with every decision, order, and fill auditable.

dp.life
dp.life is a Web3 super app that blends a decentralized wallet, discover, AI analysis, and social into one identity, connected to the compliant world through a centralized account system. It brings on-chain and off-chain life together, lowering the barrier for everyday users to enter Web3.

Profitech Securities
Profitech Securities Limited is a Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission licensed corporation (CE No. BOA307), licensed for Type 1, 4, 6, and 9 regulated activities. It connects traditional capital markets with the digital asset economy, bringing regulated-market discipline to the agentic finance conversation.

Co-Host

Pharos
Pharos is a high-performance, EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain built as global infrastructure for real-world assets, founded by former Ant Group blockchain executives. Its modular, full-stack parallel architecture targets 30,000 TPS with sub-second finality, serving institutions bringing financial assets onchain and the AI agents that hold and move them.

Blockin Ventures
Blockin Ventures is a venture capital firm focused on blockchain and Web3, backing early-stage teams building the infrastructure and applications of the onchain economy. It supports founders from inception with capital, network, and hands-on guidance.

ZeroDrift
ZeroDrift is building AI offensive security for enterprise software. Our AI agents run penetration tests and code reviews the way a real attacker would, and our security researchers verify every finding and help teams ship the fix. ZeroDrift has published CVEs in Apple, Google and Microsoft software, works with partners including Infini, BNB Chain, Sign and Flap, and is backed by YZi Labs.

Roostoo
Roostoo is building autonomous AI trading agents. Every agent is tested in live paper-trading competitions on our platform, where it builds a verifiable track record, and users can then select the agents they trust to deploy real capital on decentralized exchanges. Roostoo is backed by YZi Labs.

Andes Ventures
Andes Ventures is a Web3 venture capital firm and accelerator focused on blockchain infrastructure and related fields, having invested in dozens of projects across Europe and the United States. It backs world-class teams driving sustainable and inclusive innovation across consensus, middleware, DeFi, gaming, and social.

ACPX
ACPX is a Web3 project building at the intersection of digital assets and onchain infrastructure. It works with builders across the ecosystem to bring new products and experiences to users in the agentic finance era.

dLife
dLife is an AI4Sci project incubated by BNB Chain's MVB10. We use cryptography and smart contracts to protect and utilize personal biological data, return genome ownership to individuals, and build decentralized longevity infrastructure, with the tools the AI era demands for data security and privacy.

Techub News
Techub News is a Hong Kong-based technology media outlet covering AI, Web3, and the cross-border digital economy, with a bilingual Chinese-English newsroom and editorial teams across Asia. It brings a Hong Kong perspective on the fast-moving Web3 landscape to builders, investors, and everyday readers across the region.

Will the proposed caps and yield rules give sterling stablecoins a fighting chance, or will dollar-backed coins and tokenized bank deposits win out?

name: SuiHub Lagos: The Stable Side of Sui with Zynta
description:
Moving money across borders in Africa remains one of the hardest engineering and operational challenges in fintech. From navigating complex currency corridors to handling multi-jurisdictional compliance, building reliable payment systems requires solid rails and regulatory compliance.

Join Zynta and Sui for an intensive, 2.5-hour hands-on developer session in Lagos. We will explore how stablecoin infrastructure, multi-chain settlement rails, and unified API endpoints combine to power seamless cross-border transactions across Africa, Europe, and beyond.

Whether you are building a neobank, an enterprise payout platform, or an on/off-ramp product, this session will show you how to move from sign-up to your first live API call on production-grade payment infrastructure.

## What You Will Learn

- Unified Infrastructure: How Zynta brings payment rails, merchant tools, and institutional liquidity into a single API integration.
- On-Chain Settlement on Sui: How to leverage Sui's speed and low transaction costs for stablecoin settlement while Zynta handles fiat edges and compliance.
- Licensing as a Moat: Why inheriting fully regulated compliance structures lets developers build faster without regulatory friction.
- Go-To-Market Across Africa: Actionable strategies for selling tech across diverse African markets - including navigating regional monetary zones like WAEMU (XOF) and CEMAC (XAF).

## What to Bring

- Your Laptop & Charger: You will be writing code, testing API endpoints, and taking part in the live build challenge.
- An Idea or Project: Bring questions about payment flows you are currently designing or scaling.
Speakers

Peace Audu-Ukpoju - Chief Product Officer at Zynta Peace leads product strategy, partnerships and regulatory work, and helps build the rails businesses use to move money across Africa and beyond. Before Zynta, she worked on payments at Relm, a cross-border crypto and fiat platform, and led product teams at companies in Lagos and Abuja.

Agbakwuru Oluchi, Head of Engineering at Zynta Oluchi leads engineering at Zynta and works with businesses as a solutions engineer to help them integrate Zynta's payment rails, from the first API call to live production. She focuses on building reliable cross-border infrastructure that combines stablecoin settlement with fiat payouts across Africa and beyond

description:

We're taking over a stunning space thirty floors above Sukhumvit: skyline views, tribal-inspired interiors, live music, a fire show on the terrace, and a digital light show inside. A room built for real conversations and the kind of connections that outlast the week.

What to expect

- Conversations: where the next cycle is heading, AI and automated trading, and how the biggest traders manage risk
- Atmosphere: drinks, bites, music, and a fire show with the Bangkok skyline as the backdrop

Who should join?
Active traders and whales, KOLs and creators, exchanges, trading and DeFi projects, media, and any team looking to get in front of the people who move crypto markets, from infrastructure and L1s to consumer apps.

Partner with us: to sponsor or partner, message Mihir on Telegram (@mihirodhrani) or email mihir@tbv.xyz.

About The Best Event:
The Best Eventis the global event series where Web3 comes to life. Since 2024 we've hosted 157 events across 24 cities in 14 countries for 83,000+ guests, from intimate private dinners to large-scale nights at venues like Marquee and E11EVEN Miami. Every guest is pre-qualified through TBX, so our partners leave with a pipeline, not just a logo on a banner.

Title Partners:
Insilico Terminalis a professional-grade trading terminal built by traders, with more than $850 billion in cumulative trading volume since 2021. It brings advanced execution, order and position management into one place, with support for Hyperliquid Perps and leading crypto exchanges. Free to use.

InstaSwap is a walletless, non-custodial cross-chain swaps: 10,000+ assets across 69 chains in one transaction, with no approvals or bridging, plus perps and tokenized real-world assets.

0Gis the largest AI L1. It is a modular, infinitely scalable blockchain designed to power the future of decentralized AI. It provides the full-stack infrastructure needed to build, run, and scale AI-native applications onchain, including fast data availability, decentralized storage, and a permissionless compute network.

CheesePad is the AI-audited launchpad on BNB Chain, built for the agent economy. AI agents can join presales directly through Binance Agentic Wallet with their open-source agent skill, and projects can run "Agent ID Only" launches reserved for verified agents. Every launch is screened by their AI auditor, liquidity is locked through a transparent LP locker, and Protected Presales give buyers a refund floor against dumps.

Platinum Partners:
BoBe is a Web3 app built to distribute USDT cashback to $BOBE Bakers, straight from its own algotrading activity, 24/7. You Bake. BoBe does the rest.

ZeruAI is turning onchain behavior into an economy. Its Trust Oracles have already scored 320M+ wallets, power zScore on Etherscan, and provide behavioral intelligence for AML, credit and access. Now ZeruAI is introducing Activity Markets through Zaps - speculative markets where economic activity determines who gets to mine, miners bring supply to market, and traders decide what it's worth.

Tria is a self-custodial neobank that unifies spending, trading, and earning across all chains - without bridges, gas, or custodians. Its crypto card is accepted at 130M+ merchants in 150+ countries where Visa is supported.

Gold Partners:
Coincashy is a gateway between crypto, stablecoins and fiat: crypto processing, OTC liquidity, on/off-ramps, vIBANs and cards for businesses and individuals in 150+ countries, with compliance built in.

AthenaX - "Where New Products Begin." A discovery platform for frontier technology products and research across AI, crypto, biotech, infrastructure, robotics, RWA and developer tools.

HeyElsa is an AI crypto co-pilot that turns plain-language requests into onchain actions such as swapping, bridging and staking across chains.

Nouns - One Noun is generated and auctioned every day, forever, and all proceeds go to the Nouns DAO treasury, which funds creative and public-goods projects. The noggles are its signature, and the IP is free for anyone to use.

Strategic Partners:
TBV (TB Ventures) is a VC fund focused on leading rounds in early-stage web3 companies in Southeast Asia and North America. TBV is supported by TBE (TB Events) and TBA (TB Advisory), creating a network of services that are underpinned by a 100k+ social following and 10k+ active TG community.

name: Private Dinner with Moss
description:
## Private Dinner with Moss - BBW Bangkok

BBW 的白天已经够满了，晚上想留点时间，好好吃顿漂亮饭、聊聊 AI Agent 市场。

11 月 29 日晚上，Moss 会在曼谷组一场小范围的 Private Dinner，邀请一小群熟悉的 KOL、Builder、交易者和生态朋友，一起吃饭、喝酒、聊聊天。

## 这晚会聊什么

市场最近怎么走，AI 还有哪些东西值得继续看，Agent 到底能不能从工具变成真正的经济参与者。

过去一年，Moss 一直在做 AI Agent 和链上资产相关的产品。

最近我们正在进入下一个阶段，让 AI Agent 开始自己发行和运营资产。

这次晚宴也会和大家提前分享一些我们最近在做的东西，以及我们为什么觉得未来 Agent 会越来越像一个真正的链上经济主体。

## 时间地点

日期： 2026 年 11 月 29 日
时间： 18:30-21:30（曼谷时间）
地点： 曼谷｜具体地点审核通过后可查看

晚宴为邀请制，席位有限，报名后会进行审核。

曼谷见，来一起吃顿好的！

BBW days are already packed, so we wanted to save one evening for a good dinner and better conversations around the AI agent market.

On the evening of November 29, Moss is hosting a small private dinner in Bangkok with a curated group of KOLs, builders, traders, and ecosystem friends.

Good food, wine, and plenty of time to actually talk.

## What will we talk about?

Where the market is going, what's still worth paying attention to in AI, and whether agents can move beyond being tools and become real economic participants.

Over the past year, Moss has been building around AI agents and onchain assets.

Now we're entering the next stage: enabling AI agents to issue and manage assets themselves.

We'll share a first look at what we've been working on, and why we think agents will increasingly become real participants in onchain economies.

## Date and Time

Date: November 29, 2026
Time: 6:30-9:30 PM (Bangkok time)
Location: Bangkok - Exact venue will be shared after approval

This is an invite-only dinner with limited seats. Registrations are subject to approval.

See you in Bangkok. Come have a good dinner with us!

The Big Whale is the leading Market Intelligence provider on Digital Assets, serving 150+ banks, asset managers, fintechs and digital asset companies. Join TBW, Morgan Stanley, and other leading players for an exclusive Corporate After Bell event in New York City. Tokenized stocks, funds and bonds are now live, and issuance is no longer the bottleneck. The harder question is what happens after: where these assets trade, who provides liquidity, and how they move through custody, settlement and reporting. Most issuers earn their revenue at issuance and have little reason to build the secondary market. That leaves the job to venues, broker-dealers and banks. Some will plug tokenized assets into the desks and systems they already run. Others will build new ones. The choice will decide who captures the flows. name: AI x Strategy Workshop
description:
Build a strategy for your own business in 90 minutes, using what you already pay for.

Most people using AI are doing the same thing. One chat window, one question, one answer, close the tab. It works, it is mildly useful, and it is a fraction of what you are already paying for.

This session is for people past the beginner stage who have hit a ceiling. You know the tools. Nobody has shown you the shape they go in.

Your Host

Nabeel, from London now living in Abu Dhabi, runs Fifty Third Street, a consultancy working with pre-Series A startups, and is Managing Partner at Capital57. He has spent twenty years in startups and the last few building the AI systems he now runs his own businesses on.

What we do in the session

You bring your own numbers. Nothing theoretical, nothing from somebody else's case study.

In 90 minutes you work out where your business actually sits, what your competitors are really doing, and what it would take to move. You leave with a strategy document you wrote yourself, and a task that updates autonomously.

All of it on your own laptop, in your own account.

What you leave with

A one page strategy document for your business. A monthly task that keeps it current without you. Five prompts you can point at anything. A readiness score, taken at the start and again at the end. And a cheat sheet for your industry, in your inbox before you reach the car park.

What this is not

No slides about the future of work. No tools you have to go and buy. Everything we use is already inside a subscription you have.

Who it is for

Owners and senior people in small businesses who already use AI most weeks and suspect they are using a tenth of it.

Who it is not for

Anyone who has not used Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini before. You would spend the session watching rather than building. There will be a separate session for that.

How it works

By application. There is preparation to do in the week before, and it is the difference between a useful session and a wasted one. Sessions are recorded for our own notes, and applying counts as agreeing to that.

Three things you need before the day

1. A paid Claude account. The entry tier is enough. Free accounts cannot do the last half hour of this session.

2. The Claude desktop app, installed and signed in.

3. Signed in to the Google account you actually use for work, in the same browser.

And the preparation

Everything you build comes out of what you bring. Thin preparation, thin strategy document. Have these ready as files or notes:

- Your last three months of revenue, split by what you sell.
- Your top ten customers.
- Your current prices.
- Anyone you lost in the last six months, and why.
- Your team size and who does what.
- One page in your own words on what you think is going wrong.
- And the names of three competitors.

None of it leaves your own account or domain.

name: Tokenizar valores en Europa: ¿España o Luxemburgo?
description:
El régimen legal de Luxemburgo para la tokenización de valores ha suscitado interés en España durante los últimos años, aunque sus características siguen siendo desconocidas en buena parte del sector. En esta sesión, compararemos los dos marcos legales, el español y el luxemburgués, para entender las ventajas y desventajas de cada uno, con el apoyo de nuestros socios de Legal Node.

Nos centramos en la tokenización de instrumentos financieros (security tokens), a diferencia de los criptoactivos sujetos a MiCA.

De qué hablaremos

- ¿Qué instrumentos se pueden tokenizar en cada país y cómo (tokenización nativa frente a representación digital)?
- Límites legales y efectos sobre la propiedad.
- ERIR (España) frente a Control Agent (Luxemburgo): funciones y responsabilidades de cada figura.
- Prendas, y garantías y su ejecución sobre instrumentos tokenizados.
- Estructuras legales para la de tokenización: fondos, vehículos de titulización y estructuras de financiación. Tokenizar el vehículo frente a tokenizar su deuda.
- Negociación secundaria y futuro de la regulación.

Ponentes

- Ignacio Jiménez, socio de Legal Node
- Álvaro Garrido, socio de Legal Node
- Miguel Calero, director ejecutivo de ISBE en Alastria

name: Bitcoin meetup #30: Bitcoinové dědictví: jak předat bitcoiny další generaci
description:
Co se stane s vašimi bitcoiny, až tu jednou nebudete?

Self-custody nám dává kontrolu nad vlastními bitcoiny. Zároveň ale přináší důležitou otázku: jak zajistit, aby se k nim v budoucnu dostali naši blízcí?

Na dalším pražském meetupu Jednadvacet přivítáme Michaela Haase, seniorního produktového designéra v Trezoru. Společně se podíváme na bitcoinové dědictví, nástroje, které Bitcoin nabízí, a kompromisy mezi bezpečností, soukromím a jednoduchostí.

Probereme:

- Proč je dědictví důležitou součástí self-custody.
- Časové zámky, multisig a podmínky pro utrácení bitcoinů.
- Jak připravit přístup pro blízké, aniž bychom jim předali kontrolu příliš brzy.
- Jak dědický plán udržovat při změně peněženky, klíčů nebo rodinné situace.

Čekají vás praktické příklady, technický kontext a prostor na otázky. Univerzální řešení pro každého neexistuje, proto se budeme bavit i o omezeních a dlouhodobé správě takového plánu.

name: Bitcoin Rails Unconference: Doing business on Bitcoin Rails
description:
The Bitcoin Rails Unconference is a collaborative, participant-driven gathering designed to bring together builders, operators, treasury leaders, founders, investors, and institutional strategists to explore the evolving infrastructure and financial frameworks shaping Bitcoin's role in the global economy. Rather than a traditional stage-and-keynote format, this unconference emphasizes open dialogue, shared learning, and practical discussions led by attendees themselves - from seasoned practitioners to emerging innovators.

As Bitcoin becomes an increasingly significant component of corporate balance sheets, payment networks, financial primitives, and institutional asset portfolios, this event provides a rare space for cross-sector engagement on the real-world challenges and opportunities of Bitcoin rails. Attendees will engage directly with pioneering companies and thought leaders across core functional areas - from "buying" and "custody" to "payments," "acceptance," "investment," "yield," and "borrowing" - shaping the future of Bitcoin adoption.

What to Expect

Collaborative, Open Discussions
This unconference format empowers participants to shape conversations in real time. Sessions will emerge organically, informed by the expertise and interests of experienced practitioners, executives, and innovators in the Bitcoin ecosystem.

Strategic Insights Across the Bitcoin Value Stack
Designed for CFOs, treasurers, CIOs, and corporate decision-makers, the sessions explore Bitcoin through seven practical lenses:

Buying - How do we enter at scale, with liquidity, compliance, and minimal market impact?

Keeping - What does enterprise-grade custody and governance actually require?

Paying - Can Bitcoin improve cross-border settlement and treasury velocity?

Accepting - Does it reduce fees or unlock new revenue channels?

Investing - How does Bitcoin fit into corporate treasury and balance sheet strategy?

Yield - Can capital be deployed efficiently without compromising risk controls?

Borrowing - Can we unlock liquidity without selling strategic holdings?

Each discussion is grounded in real-world deployment -shared by leaders actively building and operating Bitcoin infrastructure today.

This is about operational clarity, governance, and capital efficiency -not speculation

Peer Exchange + Network Building
Beyond structured conversations, the unconference fosters high-signal networking. This setting is ideal for forging partnerships, exploring collaborations between finance and technology leaders, and engaging directly with companies at the forefront of Bitcoin rails innovation.

Who Should Attend
This event is crafted for corporate finance leaders, treasury operators, institutional investors, founders, ecosystem builders, compliance professionals, and anyone focused on integrating Bitcoin into operational systems, balance sheets, and financial product strategies.

name: Bitcoin Rails Unconference Day 2: From Digital Capital to Digital Credit
description:
## Digital Capital, Digital Equity and Digital Credit

Understanding, Structuring, and Investing in the Institutional Bitcoin Revolution

A one-day executive training program that explains how Bitcoin is transforming from a monetary asset into a foundation for corporate finance, capital markets, and credit creation.

This program breaks down how institutional players are using Bitcoin across balance sheets, equity structures, and credit instruments, and how to assess and invest in these emerging frameworks.

## Program Overview (1 Day | 4 Sessions)

1. Bitcoin: From Magic Internet Money to Digital Capital

A foundational session on Bitcoin's evolution into institutional-grade digital capital and its role in modern balance sheets.

2. Digital Equity: From Bitcoin Treasury to Acceleration Strategy

How companies like Strategy, Metaplanet, and Strike use Bitcoin to drive equity performance. Key frameworks include mNAV, Time to Cover, BTC Yield, and other core treasury metrics.

Lunch Break

3. 15 Innovations: From Digital Equity to Digital Credit

How Bitcoin enables new financial instruments and capital structures, including:

- Convertible bonds
- ATM issuance programs
- Preferred shares and perpetuals
- Public debt frameworks
- WKSI structures
- Digital credit creation models
- Stable credit systems
- ROC dividends
- Credit localization
- Dollar reserve strategies
- Bitcoin derivatives

4. How Preferred Instruments Work and How to Assess Them

Deep dive into Bitcoin-linked preferred structures including STRK, MERCURY, STRF, STRD, STRE, STRC, SATA, MARS.

Evaluation frameworks: BTC Rating, BTC Risk, BTC Credit, BTC Breakeven ARR, BTC Years of Dividends, USD Reserve Runway.

## Who This Is For

Owners and C-level executives from: Banks, investment funds, corporations, family offices, sovereign wealth funds, brokers, central banks, regulators, and private companies

name: Abu Dhabi Finance Week
description:
Abu Dhabi Finance Week (ADFW) 2026 is the fifth edition of the flagship financial convention hosted by the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) in Abu Dhabi from 7 to 10 December 2026. ADGM describes ADFW as the largest financial and investment convention in the Middle East and North Africa, convening policymakers, institutional investors, asset managers, entrepreneurs, and technology leaders under the theme "The Capital Community, Powered by Partnerships".

## What to expect

ADGM's published programme spans four thematic days:

- Day 1: Abu Dhabi's Falcon Economy, global markets, and macroeconomic megatrends.
- Day 2: Asset management, private markets, and wealth.
- Day 3: Artificial intelligence, fintech, digital assets, and financial innovation.
- Day 4: Sustainable finance and long-term economic resilience.

Flagship programmes named for 2026 include Asset Abu Dhabi (8 December), Fintech Abu Dhabi and Blockchain Abu Dhabi (9 December), and the Abu Dhabi Sustainable Finance Forum (10 December). The Milken Institute's Middle East and Africa Summit runs on 7 to 8 December during ADFW week.

The 2026 edition expands to about 75 events across eight stages, up from 60 events and six stages in 2025, with additional platforms spanning real estate, hedge-fund leadership, health finance, AI capital markets, and cross-border investor dialogues.

Strategic and official partners named in ADGM releases contribute dedicated tracks across asset management, fintech, digital assets, private wealth, and venture growth, including institutions such as Mubadala, First Abu Dhabi Bank, Binance, Hub71, and UBS. Satellite networking dinners, private roundtables, and Luma-listed side events across Abu Dhabi and Dubai are listed separately on Hashtag Web3 under the ADFW tag.

## Who should attend

ADFW is built for sovereign wealth and family-office principals, bank and asset-management executives, hedge-fund and private-markets allocators, regulators, fintech operators, and Web3 teams scheduling institutional meetings in the UAE during early December.

## Registration

Passes, agendas, and venue updates are published on the official ADFW site at adfw.com. Speaker names and partner activations continue to be announced ahead of December 2026.

As peças de ZK no protocolo: como as primitivas nativas do upgrade X-Ray (BN254 e Poseidon) e os verificadores ZK onchain viabilizam provas de conhecimento zero direto nos smart contracts.

Dois modelos de privacidade, lado a lado: Confidential Tokens, que escondem saldos e valores, e Privacy Pools (Stellar Private Payments), que escondem também quem paga e quem recebe.

Compliance sem abrir tudo: view keys, divulgação seletiva, association sets e controles do emissor, com privacidade para o público e visibilidade sob medida para auditores e reguladores.

Quem já está construindo: OpenZeppelin, Nethermind, Arcane e Remi, e os anúncios de privacidade do Meridian 2026.

## Merkle Science Meet: Abu Dhabi Finance Week 2026

## December 8, 2026 | 1:30 PM - 5:45 PM
Rosewood Abu Dhabi

Join Merkle Science and a distinguished group of industry leaders, institutional investors, regulators, and compliance professionals for an exclusive afternoon of discussions during Abu Dhabi Finance Week.

The event will bring together leading voices across digital assets, institutional finance, AI-driven compliance, emerging markets, and stablecoin infrastructure to explore the opportunities and challenges shaping the future of digital finance.

Agenda
Speakers & Panel Details

2:00 PM - 2:40 PM
Stablecoins & Cross-Border Payments
Stablecoins are reshaping cross-border payments, with the UAE emerging as a key hub connecting the Middle East, Asia, Europe, and Africa. This session explores how stablecoins are transforming international payments and settlement, alongside the regulatory, AML, and compliance challenges of moving value across jurisdictions.

Speakers:

- Jazib Malik - CEO & Founder, Thirdpay
- Donato P. Giarnera - BD, Arf

- Jonathan Rigg - CEO, BitOasis

Moderator: Tom Luo - Head of Sales, Merkle Science

2:55 PM - 3:35 PM
AI-Driven Compliance: Building the Next Generation of Financial Crime Detection
As financial crime becomes increasingly sophisticated, AI is transforming how financial institutions, fintechs, and digital asset businesses detect suspicious activity, identify emerging threats, and strengthen compliance frameworks. This panel explores how AI-driven analytics, blockchain intelligence, and real-time transaction monitoring are shaping the next generation of financial crime detection across the MENA region and globally. Speakers will discuss practical applications of AI in AML/CFT, cross-border payments, and digital asset investigations; the challenges of balancing innovation with regulatory expectations; and how institutions can improve detection accuracy, reduce false positives, and build scalable, intelligence-led compliance programs across jurisdictions.

Speakers:

- Adrianus Schoorl - Partner, Head of Financial Services Regulatory (MENA), DLA Piper
- Nicole Purin - Deputy General Counsel, Trustyfy (Former CCO, OKX)
- Sharad Kumar - CCO, Cyant

A conversation with Dmitry Fedotov, Head of Emerging Markets at ADGM, hosted by Mriganka Pattnaik, CEO & Co-Founder of Merkle Science.

4:10 PM - 4:50 PM
Crypto Compliance in Middle East and Emerging Markets: The Gulf, Africa, and South Asia
The UAE sits at the center of capital and payment flows connecting some of the world's fastest-growing digital asset markets, including South Asia, East Africa, and the broader Middle East. This panel examines the compliance challenges unique to these corridors: high-risk jurisdiction exposure, informal value transfer networks, hawala overlaps, and the growing role of stablecoins in markets with limited banking infrastructure. Speakers will discuss how firms operating in and through the Gulf are building compliance programs calibrated for this specific risk environment.

Speakers:

- Tristan Wallaert - CEO, Request Network
- Mehtap Onder - Managing Director, Fasset

Sovereign Wealth, Family Offices, and the Institutionalization of Digital Assets in the Gulf
Gulf sovereign wealth funds and family offices represent some of the largest pools of investable capital in the world, and their engagement with digital assets is deepening. This panel examines how these institutions are approaching digital asset allocation, from direct investment in crypto and tokenized assets to backing infrastructure and venture, what compliance and custody standards they are requiring from counterparties, and how service providers are building to meet the expectations of the region's most sophisticated capital allocators.

description:
21 seats. One table. No panel, no pitch deck.

The Institutional Table is a private, invite-only dinner hosted by QuillAudits in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday, 8 December 2026, during Abu Dhabi Finance Week.

After Dubai, Singapore, and Mumbai, the table moves to Al Maryah Island. It sits on the evening of the week's asset management and private markets day, and the night before the conversation turns to fintech and digital assets.

Banks, asset managers, sovereign-linked funds, family offices, exchanges, tokenization platforms and stablecoin issuers, in one room, talking about what it actually takes to put regulated assets on public chains without getting burned.

What we will talk about

Tokenization at scale: what breaks when a fund, bond or real estate structure moves onchain. Token standards including ERC-3643 and ERC-7518, ERC-4626 vaults, NAV oracles, transfer restrictions and the compliance layer around them.

Stablecoins as payment rails: reserve attestations, mint and burn controls, blacklist and freeze functions, and lessons from issuer exploits.

The institutional security bar: what a board, a regulator and a counterparty should be able to ask for before capital moves. Audits, formal verification, monitoring, key management and incident response.

What went wrong in 2026: a closed-door walkthrough of the year's institutional-grade incidents, and what teams should have caught earlier.

Format

Seated dinner for 21. A short opening from QuillAudits, followed by moderated conversation under the Chatham House Rule. No recording, no press, no slides.

Who is at the table

Heads of digital assets, treasury and product at banks and asset managers. Founders and CxOs of tokenization platforms and stablecoin issuers. Fund partners and family offices with RWA and stablecoin exposure. Regulators and policy leads by invitation.

description:
============== English Follows ==============
## ブロックチェーン・ハッカソン 2026
ハッカソンのテーマ：期限付き支援による災害救援金の給付
参加チームは、災害救援金を XRP Ledger（XRPL）上でプログラム可能・期限付き・監査可能な支援に変え、Ripple USD（RLUSD）で決済する、実際に動作する概念実証（PoC）を構築します。目指すのは、検証済みの被災者に支援が数か月ではなく数分で届き、1円・1ドルに至るまで端から端まで追跡でき、使われない資金が滞留せず自動的に再循環することを示すデモです。
地震、洪水、サイクロン、熱波の後、支援は遅く、不透明で、しばしば漏れが生じます。例えば、カナダでは災害支援が全額行き渡るまでに平均で約7年かかります。ドイツ・アール渓谷の300億ユーロの基金は、5年が経過しても配分済みは5分の1にとどまりました。米国連邦緊急事態管理庁（FEMA）は、本人確認と住所確認を事前に行わなかったため、ハリケーン・カトリーナおよびリタの申請において推定10億ドル（16%）を不適切または不正に支払いました。2024年の能登半島地震の後、石川県当局は支援を必要とする人を特定できませんでした。
## PoCは、以下の4つの失敗モードに対処する必要があります。
- スピード
- 現状の問題点：被害認定・申請・承認が逐次的かつ手作業で行われる
- PoCで示すべきこと：コード化されたルールに基づく数分以内の給付
- 対象の特定と漏出
- 現状の問題点：本人確認・住所確認が事前に行われない、あるいは確認が過剰で何も支払われない
- PoCで示すべきこと：被災者データベースと照合した、本人確認に紐づく受給資格の判定
- ドナーにとっての不透明性
- 現状の問題点：資金がプールされ、どのドナーも自らの資金の行き先を示せない
- PoCで示すべきこと：同一の受益者に届く各ドナー層の資金を個別に追跡可能
- 資金の滞留
- 現状の問題点：未請求の配分が、機能していない事業の中に固定されたままになる
- PoCで示すべきこと：期限付きの配分が自動的に失効し、返還される
## 実装すべき4つのレイヤーは以下のとおりです。
受給資格の検証。AIを活用した被害オラクルが、衛星・地理空間データによる評価（浸水範囲、震度、地表面温度）を、地上センサー、気象データ、位置情報付きの報告と統合し、ゾーンごとの被害スコアを算出します。模擬的な政府デジタルIDの照合により、申請者が被災ゾーンに居住していることを確認します。
プログラム可能な給付。XRPLのエスクローが、プログラムごとのルール（基本給付金、世帯あたりの上限、被害度に応じた区分、繰り返し被災した世帯への上乗せ）に従い、所定額のRLUSDを検証済みのウォレットに払い出します。
多層的なドナー資金フロー。国、都道府県、国際ドナーからの拠出金は、それぞれ固有の条件（地域、被災者区分、利用期間、使途）を伴い、個別に追跡可能な状態を保ったまま同一の受益者に決済されます。
失効と返還。すべての配分には期限があります。請求されなかったエスクロー資金は、期間終了時にプールまたは拠出元のドナーに返還されます。これこそが、本設計を単なる「速い銀行振込」と区別する特徴です。
## シナリオの例。いずれかを選ぶか、独自のシナリオを提案してください。
- 都市型地震：震度に基づくゾーンのスコアリング、高齢者や通信環境の乏しい受益者、繰り返し被災した場合の上乗せ給付、オフラインまたは代理による請求
- 河川洪水：迅速な少額給付と時間を要する高額給付を同一の基盤上で実行、条件の異なる市町村・州・連邦の各層
- 沿岸暴風雨：不正の圧力下での大量給付、重複する2つの災害にまたがる二重申請の検知
- 熱波：事前に特定された脆弱層、行動を促す少額給付、数日単位の失効期間、大規模な返還
## 成果物の目安
Testnetにデプロイされた、XRPLのエスクローおよび決済ロジック。テスト用資金はXRPLフォーセット（xrpl.org/resources/dev-tools/xrp-faucets）から取得できます。
被害オラクルとIDブリッジ（使用したデータソースと、統合・スコアリングの手法を含む）
条件の異なる2者以上のドナーを扱う、多層ドナー・ルールエンジン
配分・給付・失効・返還を表示する、ドナーおよび管理者向けダッシュボード
前提条件、脅威モデル、および実運用に必要となる条件についての簡潔な説明文書
チームは、従来の決済システムでは同等に実現できない働きをXRPLのどのプリミティブが担っているのかを、一文で説明できる必要があります。データベース上でも同じように動作するソリューションは減点されます。
参加条件
本ハッカソンは、居住地を問わずどなたでも参加できます。参加登録は必須で、リモート参加も可能です。
チームは1～6名で構成し、産業界と学術界のメンバーの混成も可能です。チームの全メンバーは、共通のチーム名でLumaに個別に登録してください。
すべての参加者は、オープニング、ピッチ、クロージングの各セッションに必ず対面で出席しなければなりません。
PoCはXRPLプロトコルを使用し、XRPL Testnet上にデプロイしてください。メインネットでの価値の移転は禁止です。
チームは、審査員による審査のため、デモの画面録画（3～5分）を提出しなければなりません。
課題の4つのレイヤー（受給資格の検証、プログラム可能な給付、多層的なドナー資金フロー、失効と返還）のすべてがデモ動画に含まれている必要があり、少なくとも1回は失効と返還を実演してください。
チームは、コードベースのGitHubリポジトリのリンクを、前提条件と脅威モデルに関する説明文書とともに共有しなければなりません。
仮想マシンまたはコンテナ化されたビルドを推奨します。審査時のデプロイ作業を最小限に抑えたソリューションは、特に考慮されます。
審査員は、オフチェーンのロジックへの依存を最小限に抑えたうえでの機能の網羅性を評価します。ID情報には、模擬データまたは合成データのみ使用できます。
参加登録とスケジュール
- 12月1日 23:59：参加登録締切
- 12月9日 14:00～16:40：ハッカソン・キックオフ
- 12月10日～11日 10:30～17:00：コーディングセッション（メンターアワーあり）
- 12月11日 23:59：提出締切
- 12月12日 11:00～11:40：選抜された10チームによるピッチ
- 12月12日 12:50～13:20：ハッカソン表彰式
時刻はすべて日本標準時（JST、UTC+9）です。
XRPLプロトコルについて
XRP Ledgerは、決済のために設計された、パブリックかつ分散型のレイヤー1ブロックチェーンです。トランザクションは3～5秒で決済され、確定的なファイナリティを備えています。つまり、トランザクションは確定するか失効するかのいずれかであり、保留状態のまま残ることはありません。手数料は1セントに満たず、事前に把握できます。
以下のリソースは、開発を始める際やハッカソン期間中に役立ちます。
XRPLでのコーディングを学ぶ：learn.xrpl.org
ドキュメント、およびTestnet・Devnetのフォーセット：xrpl.org
XRPL Commons（コミュニティ、GitHub、YouTubeチャンネル）：xrpl-commons.org
XRPL Developer Discordでは、ハッカソン期間中にプロトコルに関する質問ができます。
XRPLの基礎：docs.xrpl-commons.org/xrpl-basics
また、Rippleが2026年6月9日に公開したXRPL AI Starter Kit（Agentic Transactions）も活用できます。AIエージェントやAIを活用する開発者が、コーディングツールから直接、XRPLのウォレットと決済を構築し、資金を供給し、運用できるようにするものです。詳細は をご覧ください。
賞
12月12日にピッチを行う10チームの中から、3チームの受賞者が選ばれます。
1位：$2,500
2位：$1,500
3位：$1,000
ピッチを行う10チームすべてに参加証明書が授与されます。
主催・協賛
本ハッカソンは、京都ブロックチェーン研究センター，京都大学大学院総合生存学館，千葉工業大学が共催し、アジア太平洋地域におけるXRP Ledgerエコシステムの成長支援に取り組む非営利団体XRP Asiaの協力を得て開催されます。賞金はRippleの提供によるものです。
会場
本ハッカソンは、2026年12月9日～12日に千葉工業大学 東京スカイツリータウンキャンパス（東京ソラマチ8階、東京都）で開催されるBlockchain Kaigi 2026（
お問い合わせは、Rafik HADFI（rafik dot hadfi at i.kyoto-u.ac.jp）までご連絡ください。
## Hackathon Theme: Disaster Relief Disbursement with Time-Bound Aid
Teams build a working proof of concept that turns disaster relief money into programmable, expiring, auditable aid on the XRP Ledger (XRPL), settled in Ripple USD (RLUSD).
The success consists in a demo in which aid reaches a verified survivor in minutes rather than months, every yen or dollar must be traceable end to end, and idle money recycles itself instead of sitting in a backlog.
After earthquakes, floods, cyclones and heatwaves, aid is slow, opaque and often leaky.
For example, full disaster aid takes about seven years on average to flow in Canada.
The €30 billion Ahr valley fund was one-fifth allocated five years on.
FEMA paid an estimated $1 billion (16%) in improper or fraudulent Katrina/Rita claims because identity and address were never validated upfront.
After the 2024 Noto earthquake, Ishikawa authorities could not identify who needed help.
Your proof of concept must address the four following failure modes:
1.
Speed
- Problem: Assessment, application and approval are sequential and manual
- What the PoC must show: Release within minutes under encoded rules
2.
Targeting and leakage
- Problem: No upfront identity or address validation, or so much that nothing is paid
- What the PoC must show: Identity-linked eligibility resolved against a victim database
3.
Donor opacity
- Problem: Pooled funds, no donor can show where its money landed
- What the PoC must show: Each donor layer separately traceable to the same beneficiary
4.
Idle capital
- Problem: Unclaimed allocations stay locked in dead programmes
- What the PoC must show: Time-bound allocations that expire and revert automatically
The four layers to implement are:
1.
Verified eligibility.
An AI-assisted damage oracle fuses satellite and geospatial assessments (flood extent, shake intensity, land surface temperature) with ground sensors, weather and geolocated reports into a per-zone damage score.
A mock government digital identity check confirms the claimant lives in an affected zone.
2.
Programmable disbursement.
XRPL Escrow releases a defined RLUSD amount to the verified wallet under per-programme rules: base grants, household caps, severity tiers, top-ups for repeat-hit households.
3.
Layered donor flows.
National, prefectural and international donor contributions each carry their own conditions (geography, victim category, spending window, permitted use) and settle into the same beneficiary while staying separately traceable.
4.
Expiry and reversion.
Every allocation is time-bound.
Unclaimed escrowed funds revert to the pool or originating donor when the window closes.
This is the feature that distinguishes the design from a faster bank transfer.
Tracks and example scenarios (pick one or propose your own)
Track 1.
Urban earthquake
Zone scoring from shake intensity, elderly and low-connectivity beneficiaries, repeat-disaster top-ups, offline or delegated claiming
Track 2.
Riverine flood
Fast small grant and slow large tranche on one rail; municipal, state and federal layers with different conditions
Track 3.
Coastal storm
High-volume disbursement under fraud pressure; duplicate-claim detection across two overlapping disasters
Tack 4.
Heatwave
Pre-identified vulnerable cohort, small behavioural payouts, days-long expiry windows, reversion at scale
Suggested deliverables
- XRPL escrow and settlement logic deployed on Testnet.
Test funds can be obtained from the XRPL faucet at xrpl.org/resources/dev-tools/xrp-faucets.
- Damage oracle and identity bridge, with data sources and the fusion or scoring method used
- Layered-donor rule engine with at least two donors carrying different conditions
- Dashboard for donors and administrators showing allocation, release, expiry and reversion
- Short written note on assumptions, threat model, and what would need to be true for a real deployment
Teams should be able to state in one sentence which XRPL primitive does work that a conventional payment system cannot do as well.
Solutions that would run equally happily on a database will be marked down.
## Participation Criteria
The hackathon is open to all, regardless of geographic location.
Registration is mandatory, and remote participation is allowed.
- The teams may have up to 1-6 members and may mix industry and academia.
All team members register individually on Luma under a common team name.
- All participants MUST attend the opening, pitching, and closing sessions in person.
- The proof of concept must use the XRPL protocol, deployed on XRPL Testnet.
No mainnet value transfer.
- Teams must submit a screen recording of their demo (3 to 5 minutes) for review by the judges.
- All four layers of the challenge (verified eligibility, programmable disbursement, layered donor flows, expiry and reversion) must be present in the demo video, including at least one live expiry and reversion.
- Teams must share a GitHub repository link for their codebase, together with the written note on assumptions and threat model.
- Virtual machines or containerised builds are recommended.
Solutions that minimise deployment effort during evaluation receive special consideration.
- The jury judges feature coverage with minimum reliance on off-chain logic.
Only mock or synthetic identity data may be used.
## Registration & Timeline
- December 1, 23:59 - Registration closes
- December 9, 14:00-16:40 - Hackathon Kickoff
- December 10-11 10:30AM-5PM - Coding sessions with scheduled mentor hours
- December 11, 23:59 - Submission deadline
- December 12, 11:00-11:40 - Pitches from 10 shortlisted teams.
- December 12, 12:50-13:20 - Hackathon Awards Ceremony
All times are Japan Standard Time (JST, UTC+9).
## Know About the XRPL Protocol
The XRP Ledger is a public, decentralised layer-1 blockchain designed for payments.
Transactions settle in 3 to 5 seconds with deterministic finality, meaning they either confirm or expire and never sit pending.
Fees are a fraction of a cent and are known in advance.
The following resources will help you get started and support you throughout the hackathon.
- Learn to code on the XRPL at learn.xrpl.org.
- Documentation and the Testnet and Devnet faucets are available at xrpl.org.
- XRPL Commons offers a community along with GitHub and YouTube channels at xrpl-commons.org.
- The XRPL Developer Discord is the place to ask protocol questions during the hackathon.
- XRPL Basics at docs.xrpl-commons.org/xrpl-basics.
Teams may also wish to explore the XRPL AI Starter Kit (Agentic Transactions), released by Ripple on June 9, 2026.
It lets AI agents and AI-assisted developers build, fund and operate XRPL wallets and payments directly from their coding tools.
See
## Awards
Three winners are selected from the ten teams that pitch on December 12:
- First prize: $2,500
- Second prize: $1,500
- Third prize: $1,000
All ten pitching teams receive a certificate of participation.
## Hosts and Sponsors
This Hackathon is co-hosted by Kyoto University, Chiba Institute of Technology, with assistance from XRP Asia, a non-profit dedicated to supporting the growth of the XRP Ledger ecosystem in APAC.
Prizes are sponsored by the Ripple Impact - University Blockchain Research Initiatives (UBRI) programme.

For any queries, please contact Rafik HADFI at rafik dot hadfi at i.kyoto-u.ac.jp.

name: Cibersegurança na era da IA
description:
Quem consegue mover os fundos na sua aplicação? Se a resposta for "uma pessoa só", você tem um risco interno.

A maioria dos incidentes graves de custódia não vem de um atacante externo sofisticado. Vem de alguém com acesso demais: um desenvolvedor com a chave no ambiente, um operador que cria e aprova a mesma transação, um servidor online que assina o que lhe pedem.

Vamos mostrar na prática como desenhar isso fora do sistema, com uma demonstração na rede Stellar usando a DINAMO Cold Wallet:

Segregação de funções. Quem monta a transação (ambiente online) não é quem assina (estação fria air-gapped). Nenhum dos dois faz o trabalho do outro.

Divisão de responsabilidade. A chave nasce e vive dentro do HSM. Os fragmentos da cerimônia de chaves são distribuídos e conferidos por KCV. Ninguém, sozinho, tem a chave completa.

Verificação independente. A estação fria exibe os campos decodificados da transação e códigos de validação (AES-256-CMAC). Quem aprova confere o que realmente vai ser assinado, não que o sistema online diz que vai.

Sem superfície de rede. A estação de assinatura não tem conexão com o ambiente online. A única ponte são envelopes selados em QR code. Não há canal para um atacante interno explorar.

No fim, você vê uma transação Stellar ser montada online → validada e assinada offline → publicada → confirmada na rede.

Para quem desenvolve em fintech, blockchain, custódia ou segurança: é um exemplo concreto de secure by design, em que o controle está na arquitetura e não na confiança nas pessoas.

Where are the real business opportunities? How can Europe remain competitive? What does it take to implement digital asset solutions securely and successfully? And how can organizations navigate the growing complexity of regulation and compliance?

During the forum, we'll explore these questions from both a strategic and practical perspective, covering topics including:

Connect with professionals from banks, fintechs, financial institutions, technology companies and the wider blockchain ecosystem.

We'll close the afternoon with networking drinks, giving everyone the opportunity to continue conversations, exchange ideas and build new relationships.

We thought this would be something for our members: a breathwork session hosted at the beautiful Sosoul Amsterdam. No crypto talk, no networking pressure, just space to reset and be with other women from the community without a

- attached. Never done breathwork before? It's a guided practice using conscious breathing patterns to shift your nervous system out of fight-or-flight and into actual rest. No experience needed, you just show up and breathe

Walk in between 19:30 and 20:00, doors close right at 20:00 when the breathwork starts. From there, our guide takes the group through a full breathwork practice designed to release tension you didn't even know you were holding, the kind that sitting still never quite reaches. Come as you are; loose, comfortable clothing helps. Mats and props are provided. Afterward, there's a few quiet minutes to notice how you feel, and time to talk with the person next to you or whoever's in the room, before we close out around 22:00. name: Workshop: Navigating Cyber Threats Across the Onchain Ecosystem
description:
Welcome to The Studio Workshop Series: sessions designed for founders who are building right now. Each workshop takes one skill that directly affects how you fundraise, grow, or ship, and breaks it down into concrete steps you can apply to your own startup:
- : Doors open 5:30 PM: Workshop 6:30 PM: Networkin

About the workshop Every team building onchain is a target. Attackers move fast, from wallet drainers and fake tokens to exploits that trick users into signing something different from what they saw. The better you understand how these attacks work, the better you can design against them. Join Meg Yodfat and Noah Newfield from Blockaid to break down the threats hitting builders today and how to stop them. We'll walk through real attack patterns, map them to a security lifecycle for building dApps, from threat modeling and audits to deployment, and show how teams use real-time monitoring and transaction validation to protect protocols and users once they're live. Bring your questions and a product or flow you'd like pressure-tested. We'll use teams in the room as live case studies, and you'll leave with a practical security checklist for your own build

About the speaker

Meg Yodfat Meg is Director of Customer Success at Blockaid, where she partners with every customer, from leading wallets and exchanges to chains and onchain protocols, to shape their security strategy and defend against threats ranging from wallet drainers and phishing to protocol exploits. She brings over a decade of experience in business development, partnerships, and revenue leadership. Before Blockaid, she was Head of Revenue at Infront Lab, led business development and partnerships at the blockchain startup Leeway, co-founded the startup Bobe

Noah Newfield Noah's been in crypto for 9+ years. He's worked on GTM at companies like Uniswap, Share, and Conduit. Prior to Blockaid he built a Stablecoin consumer company in YCombinator. He's now on the Customer Success team at Blockaid where he helps clients solve their most pressing security and business proble

About Blockaid is the security layer behind the world's leading crypto platforms, protecting users, assets, and business operations from fraud, exploits, and malicious activity at scale

It is 100% equity-free: zero equity, zero fees. Teams get dedicated desks, hands-on support on pitch, GTM, and fundraising, and direct access to the VCs, angels, and mentors who work from the space alongside them. name: Snowfro: Press Start
description:
NODE is pleased to announce Snowfro: Press Start, an interactive exhibition of Erick Calderon's art, code, and play.

Erick is a pioneering figure and a central node in the onchain generative art community. As artist and entrepreneur, he treats code as a living medium and dedicates himself to elevating this practice within the world of contemporary art.

At the center of Calderon's practice is a belief that art can be playful and interactive. This aligns with NODE's focus on digital art education through participation rather than mere observation. Five principal works, created between 2020 and 2026, were selected for the exhibition and reveal a carefully woven story across technology and time.

Snowfro: Press Start arrives at a moment of reflection and renewal. Across more than a decade of making art, and through the intense, formative years surrounding the creation of Chromie Squiggle and Art Blocks, Calderon's practice has evolved through experimentation, ambition, and persistence.

For the first time, NODE offers an opportunity to gather these threads and look back at the ideas that have shaped his path as an artist.

name: Off the Beaten Vine: CWC wine tasting
description:
Most wine on our shelves comes from a handful of big names. Some of the best bottles never make it that far.

For our first evening of 2027, Crypto Women Collective is teaming up with Alyssa Gammoudy of Mijn Wijnproeverij. By day, Alyssa is a crypto journalist. Beyond that, she brings the same curiosity to wine. She works with smaller, lesser known wine houses in France: family producers making exceptional wine without access to the big markets. She finds them, tastes with them and brings their bottles to people who would never otherwise come across them.

This February, she's bringing seven of them to us.

THE TASTING

- Round 1: a bubble to start
- Rounds 2 to 4: three whites
- Rounds 5 and 6: two reds
- Round 7: a dessert wine to finish

Alyssa will share the story behind each house and what to taste for, with bites to go with the wines. Like every CWC evening, it's also a room full of women to meet, catch up with and swap stories with.

GOOD TO KNOW

- Duration: about two hours
- Ticket: €25, which comes back to you as credit on your first order with Alyssa
- Food: bites are served alongside the wines, so come straight from work
- Places: we're keeping it small, with 15 places, so there's room for real conversation
- Experience: none needed with wine or with crypto. Just come curious
- Small producers: every order supports a small, independent wine house
- Gift: looking for a present? A ticket makes a lovely one

We can't wait to raise a glass with you.

name: Wealth Tech Executive Forum | Geneva Edition
description:
🇨🇭 The Wealth Tech Executive Forum: Geneva Edition is an invite-only executive series for senior leaders in asset and wealth management shaping the future of capital allocation, digital assets, and institutional infrastructure.

On the 27th August 2026, in Geneva, a select group of Switzerland's leading institutional allocators and technology experts gather to discuss the latest innovations in asset and wealth management, how technology is reshaping the investment stack, and what it takes to stay ahead of the next wave of disruption.

The event series is brought to you by CV VC, with SCRYPT as the main partner.

Participants will

- gain actionable insights into the latest trends, and
- expand their high-class network

## Why This Conversation Matters

As global financial markets transform, tokenization, programmable settlement, and AI-driven structuring are actively redefining institutional allocation strategies. A new investment era is emerging across digital asset products, market infrastructure, portfolio construction, distribution, and institutional access.

🇨🇭 Geneva, a leading financial center and a global hub for digital assets, DLT, and AI innovation, provides the ideal environment for this critical dialogue.

## Who is attending?

This edition is designed to convene a select cohort of senior decision-makers, including executives from:

- Asset Managers and Institutional Allocators
- Family Office Principals
- Hedge Fund Portfolio Managers
- CIOs and senior portfolio managers from leading Swiss & global Asset managers & Private banks
- Representatives from institutional-grade technology and infrastructure platforms
- Selected innovators shaping the future of asset management

## Core Themes for Discussion

The focused content will explore the following key areas:

- Allocator perspectives on digital asset exposure
- Market structure, trading access, and execution
- The evolution of asset management: from ETFs to on-chain vaults
- Innovation in practice: allocation, risk, and operating models
- Institutional readiness: infrastructure, governance, and regulation
- Portfolio implications for forward-looking allocators
- Closed-door roundtable discussion among peers

## Event Format - Efficient and Focused

The evening format is intentionally compact and highly time-efficient.

This design allows participants to gain relevant and actionable insights, and forge meaningful connections in a high-calibre setting without requiring a full day away from the office.

## Attendance Note

Attendance is strictly limited and subject to approval to ensure a high-quality, peer-level exchange. Chatham rules apply.

## Other Editions in the Series:

- Zurich (Concluded)
- UAE
- Frankfurt

Find out more on our website:

## What Comes Next?

The Next Disruption in Asset Management? Asset management has evolved in distinct waves, each driven by structural innovation and enabled by technology:

1770s: Closed-End Funds 1920s: Open-End Mutual Funds 1970s: Index Funds 1990s: ETFs 2020s: A new paradigm emerging: Vaults?

Technological innovations in digital trading and programmatic trading gave rise to ETFs in the 1990s, which now account for around $20 trillion in AUM. Technology continues to evolve, and with it comes the next major disruption in asset management.

Is the next reinvention of asset management already happening in front of us?

The real question is not whether asset management will continue to be reinvented, but which investors will identify the next structural change early enough to benefit from it?

This forum will explore exactly that.

## Hosts CV VC - We invest in blockchain. Because it's more than tech.

About the organiser: CV VC is an Early-Stage VC backing Pre-Seed & Seed founders leveraging AI, Blockchain & other Frontier Technologies. Connect with investors, industry leaders, & senior executives at one of our events

name: ZIG Summit 2027
description:
ZIG Summit 2027 Nothing compounds alone.

Capital. Products. Infrastructure. Distribution. Together.

On 25 March 2027, ZIG Finance brings together the people building, funding and powering the next era of onchain finance for one day in Dubai.

Why attend?

Capital, product, regulated infrastructure and distribution. ZIG Summit brings all four sides of the market to the same table, alongside the community driving onchain finance forward.
- Meet the capital: allocators, asset managers, family offices and institutions looking at investable onchain products.
- Find distribution: banks, platforms and distributors across the UAE and beyond.
- See what is launching: tokenized funds, private credit and structured yield brought to market.
- Get practical on regulation: the rules that decide where products can be issued, distributed and accessed, including the UAE and emerging markets.
- Keep the conversation going: a curated room built for business, with networking from stablecoins to custody one conversation away.

What we will cover
- Tokenized financial products: private credit, tokenized funds, structured yield and real-world assets
- Stablecoins and financial rails: payments, settlement, liquidity, custody and institution-ready access
- Institutional capital and distribution
- Regulation and market access
- Community and adoption

Who should attend

The people shaping onchain finance, all in one room. From the people funding the future of onchain finance to those building its products, infrastructure and distribution, ZIG Summit brings together the businesses driving the industry forward.
- Capital allocators: asset managers, institutional investors, family offices and wealth platforms
- Financial institutions: banks, exchanges, custodians and payment firms building regulated rails
- Product originators and issuers: teams issuing tokenized funds, private credit, structured yield and real-world assets
- Builders and community: founders, developers and the wider onchain finance community

Last edition

The 2026 summit in Dubai (28 April 2026) brought together 2,000+ attendees in person, 50+ speakers and 30,000+ livestream views, with institutions representing over $3 trillion in assets.

About ZIG Finance

ZIG Finance is the onchain finance ecosystem built on a single conviction: institutional investment opportunities belong onchain, open to everyone. That belief predates the chain. The founding team built Zignaly, an investment platform that grew past 600,000 users on the strength of better access alone. ZIG Finance represents that same conviction at a different scale. ZIG Chain provides the institutional-grade infrastructure. ZIG Markets structures and distributes financial products across onchain and offchain channels. $ZIG sits at the economic center of the ecosystem. Together, they connect the infrastructure, products and distribution needed to bring financial activity onchain.

Speakers and partners will be announced soon. Register now to secure your place.
